'''2019 North American Continental Championship''' (John Anderson Memorial) was the Players Committee North American Continental Championship, August 2019. [[Greg Shaw]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-north-american-continentals/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' August 2019
